**Summary**  
The GNN-A model estimates a 13.1% risk of stage III–IV disease for C3N-00194 [pred:C3N-00194:gnn]. The prediction is driven mainly (84% share) by the tumor’s protein expression profile—especially C2orf69, FGF1, TSPAN31, GRB14, TJP1, LMO7, ARHGAP5, RFK and KBTBD4 [contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:205327][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:2246][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:6302][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:2888][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:7082][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:4008][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:394][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:55312][contrib:C3N-00194:NCBIGene:55709]—with a smaller contribution (16% share) from the recorded comorbidity asthma [contrib:C3N-00194:HP:0002099]. The tumor carries somatic VHL p.N90I, ERBB2 p.Q943K and NSD1 p.H2235Y mutations [pt:C3N-00194:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428][pt:C3N-00194:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:2064][pt:C3N-00194:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:64324] and shows strong upregulation of hypoxia/ECM (LOXL2, LOX, GFPT1), iron/ferritin (FTH1), apoptosis (CASP8), ribosome biogenesis (NPM1, GNL3L) and flavin metabolism (RFK) proteins, alongside downregulation of cytoskeletal (ARHGAP5, DYNLL2), transcriptional (NR2F1, ZNF143) and ubiquitin (SIAH1) regulators [pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:4017][pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:4015][pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:2673][pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:2495][pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:841][pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:4869][pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:54552][pt:C3N-00194:protein_up:NCBIGene:55312][pt:C3N-00194:protein_down:NCBIGene:394][pt:C3N-00194:protein_down:NCBIGene:140735][pt:C3N-00194:protein_down:NCBIGene:7025][pt:C3N-00194:protein_down:NCBIGene:7702][pt:C3N-00194:protein_down:NCBIGene:6477].
